name: Liquidity Sweep Scalping
description: Scalping strategy based on fake-out / stop-hunt patterns. Price wicks beyond a 50-bar swing high or low but closes back inside, signalling a rejection zone. Entry on M1 when price re-enters the sweep zone; EMA 50/200 for trend filter; FVG and S/D flip for confluence.
hypothesis: Liquidity sweeps (fake-outs beyond swing highs/lows that close back inside) leave behind high-probability rejection zones. Price re-testing these zones with EMA trend alignment and FVG/S/D confluence produces reliable scalping entries. ML learns which combinations of sweep recency, zone proximity, trend alignment, and displacement are most predictive.
expected_outcome: Edge on liquid index and FX markets during active sessions. lsw_bull_active / lsw_bear_active and recency features selected as important. Higher win rate when EMA 50/200 trend aligns with sweep direction.
